title: The Uniform of Port Mahon
author: Yara Dravenmoor
blurb: Ada Joubert, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
